difficulty_reason: Smooth locus of a family of curves: the maximal smooth open U of the where-smooth lemma has base-change stable formation, its complement T is closed since f is proper, and S' = S minus f(T) is the desired open; the smooth-1 variant follows by intersecting with the CM-1 substack since smooth fibres are Cohen-Macaulay. Retained author proof at lines 1762-1787.
